program.name: Loaded Balance
program.subject: Balance & stability
program.blurb: Single-leg strength with dumbbells and a kettlebell: balance that holds up under load.
program.about: Single-leg strength with weights, for balance that holds up when you carry or lift. Split squats, single-leg deadlifts, step-ups and suitcase marches are done one side at a time in straight sets, with a balance drill between. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds reps.
